features.description: The published page opens in light mode
An explicit toggle switches the published page to dark mode
Left and Right arrow keys page the stages and keep the scroll position
Copy the real JSON going into a stage, with success or failure shown beside the button
Download an example's pipeline and input, with success or failure shown beside the button
Every shipped pipeline runs on its shipped input and its output is asserted
Examples 02 to 10 run with Jev unreachable and send records to the safe destination
A record Jev did not answer is held, resubmitted and handed to review after 15 attempts
Known routine INFO lines skip the model by exact match on level, service and message
The adapter runs as a ServiceAccount whose grants match its kubectl calls
The pod-labels pipeline is exercised on a real k3d cluster
Real labels the agent added expire after about ten seconds
Investigations judge whether evidence is enough without proposing a label change
The live board follows nothing deployed, Expanso alone, then Expanso with Jev
The Jev switch deploys the recurrence pipeline over the running job and back
Break the link to Jev makes calls fail so the hold and the release can be watched
Clicking a bucket shows the latest record's full JSON grouped by who added each field
Inject a named log line at the source and follow it through the pipeline
A tab shows the checked-in YAML of either pipeline
The evidence strip shows the severity-only baseline, what Jev reported and where the record landed
The pod board offers a label lane and an investigate lane on three ordinary pods
Events fire on their own and can be paused or sent on demand from the legend

browser_assertions.description: No horizontal page scroll at 320, 400, 768 and 1440 pixels in light and dark
All visible text meets WCAG AA contrast in light and dark
A successful and a failed copy each say so beside the button
A successful and a failed download each say so beside the button
Right then Left returns to the starting stage with the scroll position unchanged
